items.name: idea
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: An idea, or a repo with no docs/brief.md
items.why: Grill it into docs/brief.md: problem, people, core flows, key screens, surface, v1, out of scope.

items.name: direction
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: A brief with UI and no direction yet, or one piece to find
items.why: References and patterns from what you like, picked on a moodboard. Writes design-exploration/<slug>/direction.md, a proposal.

items.name: design
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: A direction to turn into screens
items.why: Prototype the key screens, approve, write DESIGN.md, then build them in Figma.

items.name: design-check
items.author: Long Beard
items.when: A Figma screen, or a built UI spec, to check
items.why: Against the design rules and the Ready frame. Hard rules block; soft ones are reported.

items.name: figma-use
items.author: Figma
items.why: The Plugin API rules every Figma write follows.

items.name: figma-generate-library
items.author: Figma
items.when: Tokens, styles, or components in Figma
items.why: Variables, text styles, and components that match the code.

items.name: figma-generate-design
items.author: Figma
items.why: Compose it from the file's components and tokens.

items.name: figma-design-to-code
items.author: Figma
items.why: A designer handed it over. Needs the Figma connection. Reuse this project's components.

items.name: animate
items.author: emilkowalski
items.when: They asked to animate a control or a transition
items.why: Read the Behaviour section of DESIGN.md first. A page design-taste-frontend is building keeps that skill’s motion. Decide this one move, then build it.

items.name: jury
items.author: juliobsz
items.when: They asked to jury, score, judge, or roast the design (or a live URL / local build)
items.why: Blind evidence scorecard. Do not redesign. Fixes stay on the board, DESIGN.md, or Figma. Do not run after every build unless they asked.

items.name: web-design-guidelines
items.author: Vercel
items.when: A UI review you asked for

items.name: security-audit
items.author: Cloudflare
items.when: A security review you asked for
items.why: Look for a broken trust boundary. The full audit runs only when you ask for an audit or a pen-test.

items.name: image-to-code
items.author: Leonxlnx
items.why: Build the page from that picture.
